intro: Turkmen culture is famous for carpets, horses and nomadic traditions.

chapters.title: Carpets
text: Deep-red Turkmen carpets with their gul patterns are so important that carpet designs appear on the national flag.

chapters.title: Horses
text: The Akhal-Teke horse, with its shining coat, is a national symbol and appears on the coat of arms.

keyTerms.meaning: A medallion pattern in Turkmen carpets.

items.title: Chorek

items.text: Bread baked in a clay oven.

items.title: Melons
items.subtitle: Summer
items.text: There is a national Melon Day.
